description: Returns single-property CMBS loans as operating comparables: revenue, operating expenses, NOI (each per square foot), expense ratio, occupancy, DSCR and valuations, filtered by property type, metro, state, size and year built, with medians over every match. Use it for market operating benchmarks; use search_loans for loan status and terms.

limit.description: Up to 25 free, 400 with a Pro or Team key; the medians always cover every match
